notes: The margin ("Or, aught that the poor desired") was read and set aside (rule 38).

The italic *their* answers to no suffix or other possessive morpheme — דַּלִּים already holds its own *the poor* — so it is `added` under rule 18's closing sentence; the italic corroborates without deciding (rule 7).
*have caused ... to fail* is a causative rendered as a light verb plus complement, headed on *fail* and discontinuous under rule 25 (rule 44).
